note: Novo Banco's standard information sheets (Fichas de Informação Normalizada) for each of its personal credit cards, read 2026-10-30: the Verde VISA (07/2026; 13.900% a year nominal, a card fee of 13.00 euros a year), Gold VISA (07/2026; 14.600%, 25.00 euros; also sold as the Gold 360, which links the same sheet), Platinum (07/2026; 16.250%, 110.00 euros) and Branco (04/2026; 0.000% and paid in full each month, so nothing is carried; 65.00 euros a year). Each: stamp duty (IS) of 4% on interest and on the card fee, written as the tax (the 0.141% stamp duty on credit used isn't one of the game's terms and isn't written); a minimum payment of 5% of the capital owed (the Branco none, being paid in full); a recovery charge of 4% of an instalment due and unpaid, at least 12 and at most 150 euros, written as the late fee on the minimum; and late interest at the card's rate plus 3% a year, written as the penalty rate (16.9%, 17.6%, 19.25%). The card fee was written in the earlier reading of the Verde VISA (2026-10-29) as 13.52 euros with its stamp duty folded in; it is now the 13.00 fee with the 4% tax. The sheets state no cash advance or foreign transaction fee, nor a grace period. Instalment payments aren't written. The main banks: Caixa Geral de Depósitos, Millennium bcp and Novo Banco; only Novo Banco's sheets were reached on 2026-10-30.
